name: scrape_url
description: Read a web page's text content. Use AFTER search_web: pick the 2-3 most promising result URLs and scrape each one rather than guessing from snippets alone. Handles JS-heavy pages (engine auto). Returns clean text under a fixed character budget: if truncated, the middle is stored to a file and the reply names it — read that file (with line ranges) to continue. Prefer narrower queries or site: searches over scraping many pages. When `prompt` is set, a cheap model answers the question from the page content instead of returning raw text.

char_limit.description: Optional character budget for the returned text (default 15000, clamped 2000-500000). Raise only for pages you know are dense with needed detail.

prompt.description: Optional question to answer from the page; when set, a cheap model answers from the page content instead of returning raw text
